newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: PDVSA unit says no fires at Cardon refinery.
newsitem.headline: PDVSA unit says no fires at Cardon refinery.

text.p: Venezuela's Maraven, a unit of state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela SA (PDVSA), denied market rumors Wednesday of a fire at its Punta Cardon refinery in northwest Venezuela.
"The refinery is perfectly normal, there are no problems and definitely no fire," a spokesman at the plant said.
The spokesman added that rumors of a fire could have been caused by recent fire drills, one of which took place at about 1100 EDT/1500 GMT.
Officials at PDVSA added that they had no knowledge of fires at any of its other refineries.
